ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High. The visible ventral surface consists of approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (off-white/light grey) and 35% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) concentrated at the margins and within scratch patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central regions on both lobes. Low-intensity pixels are mapped as a continuous border along the leading and trailing edges, with dense, non-contiguous dark mottling and linear clusters concentrated near the peduncle and across the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 20% of the total vertical height of the fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, multi-amplitude serrations. Inner trailing edges show fine-scale peaks (<5 pixels), while distal regions transition to high-amplitude, jagged irregularities (15-30 pixels) resulting from calcified growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trajectory on the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips with significant textural distortion.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, high-contrast circular pixel groups located exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, representing dense barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the central high-intensity zones of both lobes; highest density is observed on the lower half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface and significant calcified barnacle colonies at the fluke tips altering the natural geometric silhouette.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique combination of hyper-serrated tips due to barnacle accumulation and a distinct, dark vertical stripe extending from the median notch toward the peduncle.
